gloss: best in Japan, Japan's number one

definitions.gloss: best in Japan, number one in Japan
definitions.explanation: The top or finest in all of Japan. Used to describe something that ranks first nationwide in some quality or measure.

examples.japanese: {日本一|にっぽんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧だ。
examples.english: The tallest mountain in Japan is Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: {日本一|にっぽんいち}⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: I went up the tallest building in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本一|にっぽんいち}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant's ramen is said to be the best in Japan.

notes:
Can be read as either にっぽんいち or にほんいち, but にっぽんいち is more common and emphatic.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日本一|にっぽんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: the best/greatest ~ in Japan
- ～⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本一|にっぽんいち}だ: ~ is the best in Japan
- {日本一|にっぽんいち}⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: the tallest/most expensive in Japan

USAGE:
Often paired with superlative-like adjectives (⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧, ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧, ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧, ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧, etc.). Can also be used subjectively to express strong praise.

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- ⟦{世界一|せかいいち}→世界一：16531_sekaiichi⟧: the best in the world
- {地域一|ちいきいち}: the best in the area
- ～⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧: number one in ~
